scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,worker -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/worker"
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/worker && npm test -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.aws:bootstrap: curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:4566/moto-api/reset && cd infra/local && rm -f terraform.tfstate terraform.tfstate.backup && terraform init -input=false >/dev/null && terraform apply -input=false -auto-approve
